# Frame prototype

## C top outside, bottom row

<table>
<tr><td><a href="../setup/macos.md"><img src="../assets/tabs/setup/macos-selected.994fae07.svg" alt="macOS (selected)" width="105" height="48" align="top"></a><a href="../setup/linux.md"><img src="../assets/tabs/setup/linux.d436ca60.svg" alt="Linux" width="94" height="48" align="top"></a><a href="../setup/windows.md"><img src="../assets/tabs/setup/windows.29eccf1f.svg" alt="Windows (WSL2)" width="170" height="48" align="top"></a><a href="../setup/macos.md"><img src="../assets/tabs/setup/count.4c2577da.svg" alt="3 systems" width="91" height="48" align="top"></a></td></tr>
<tr><td>

**1. Node.js 22.12+** from [nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/), plus your app's own runtime. That is all the [simplest path](../start/simplest.md) needs.

**2. For a database, one gateway URL and the same container you deploy**, also start Docker Desktop, OrbStack or Colima, and install Tilt:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tilt-dev/tilt/master/scripts/install.sh \
  | bash
```

**3. Install Flisk and check the machine:**

```bash
npm install -g @flisk-sh/flisk
flisk doctor
```

`flisk doctor` checks only what your project uses and prints a fix for anything missing. Full steps: [macOS setup](../setup/macos.md).

</td></tr>
<tr><td><img src="mac-bottom.svg" alt="Apple M1" width="100%" align="top"></td></tr>
